summary: Iteration 9 testing of exam engine redesign (ExamTopBar + Palette + QuestionPanel + Pause). Backend 4/4 pytest tests pass: attempt payload includes test_title/pause_left_seconds (900)/user_name/server_now; POST /attempts/{id}/pause saves answers+marked, is idempotent (second pause returns {status:'paused'}), decrements pause_left_seconds on resume (verified <900 after ~2s pause); POST /attempts/{id}/pause returns 400 'Pause is not available for this test' when allow_pause=false; sectional pause freezes section_ends_at + section_remaining_at_pause. Frontend: all required data-testids present on exam page (exam-header, exam-title, exam-marking, exam-timer, exam-user hidden <xl, exam-fullscreen-btn, exam-pause-btn, exam-submit-btn, question-counter, option-A..D, clear-response-btn, mark-review-btn, prev-btn, next-btn, palette-panel, stat-answered/not-answered/marked/not-visited, palette-q-N). Verified: answering an option increments stat-answered from 00->01; mark-review-btn flips to Unmark and stat-marked=01; palette-q-3 jump updates 'Question 3 of 10'; exam-pause-btn opens pause-overlay with pause-remaining frozen (00:59:57) and pause-left starting at 00:14:59 and decrementing (00:14:58 after 1.5s); resume-test-btn closes overlay and returns to in-progress; fullscreen click does not crash; mobile 390 hides palette-panel and shows open-palette-btn which opens full-screen palette with palette-close; submit flow via exam-submit-btn opens exam-confirm-dialog with exam-confirm-submit button that navigates to /result/{id}. Admin test form: test-allow-pause-input checkbox present at /admin/tests and persists via PUT /content/tests/{id} (backend test verified).

critical_code_review_comments: ExamPage.jsx is 193 lines — well-structured and under 700-line budget. Good separation into ExamTopBar/Palette/QuestionPanel/PauseOverlay.
Backend _pause_allowed() excludes tests with live_start_at - correct and matches requirement, verified indirectly via NON_SECTIONAL_TEST (no live_start_at) and SECTIONAL_TEST both allowing pause.
Backend pause endpoint accepts AutosaveIn so answers sent at pause time ARE persisted (confirmed by GET /attempts/{id} returning saved answer after pause). Good.
pause update uses conditional filter {paused_at: None} to avoid double-pause race - good concurrency guard.
ExamTopBar palette grid uses `palette-q-${n}` where n is a running counter over all groups - consistent with required flat 1..N numbering across sections. Good.
Minor: stat-not-answered counts only VISITED-and-unanswered which is standard CBT convention; good UX.
exam-user is correctly hidden on <xl (hidden xl:flex) matching requirement 'user name xl screens only'.

rca of the issue: Mobile overflow RCA: the sticky bottom bar in QuestionPanel.jsx groups 4 buttons (Clear, Mark/Unmark, Prev, Save & Next). Clear uses `hidden sm:inline` on text, Mark splits via sm:inline/sm:hidden, Prev has `hidden sm:inline` on 'Prev'.
